stories.title: Eyüpsultan'da başkanvekili CHP ve YENİ Parti'nin adayı Parlak oldu

en.title: Vice chairman of Eyüpsultan becomes candidate of CHP and YENİ Party with Parlak
en.summary: Following the detention and removal of Eyüpsultan Municipality Mayor Mithat Bülent Özmen, the vice mayoral position has been filled, with Parlak emerging as the joint candidate of the CHP and YENİ Party.

stories.title: Kahramanmaraş’tan 14 ile uzanan silah kaçakçılığı ağı çökertildi

en.title: Weapons smuggling network extending from Kahramanmaraş to 14 provinces dismantled
en.summary: Police operations across 14 provinces targeting organized crime groups and weapons smugglers resulted in the arrest of 195 suspects involved in an illegal arms trafficking network.

stories.title: Ünlü market zinciri de fona para kaptırmış: Finansal varlıklarının yaklaşık %20,4 'lük bölümü

en.title: Well-known supermarket chain loses funds: approximately 20.4% of financial assets
en.summary: Mopaş supermarket chain had approximately 20.4 percent of its total 2.52 billion Turkish lira in financial assets tied up in the liquidation process of Hedef Portfolio Money Market Fund.

stories.title: Yem kırma makinesine düştü, feci şekilde can verdi

en.title: Fell into feed grinding machine, died tragically
en.summary: A 63-year-old man in Eskişehir died after falling into a feed grinding machine while preparing feed for animals.

stories.title: SON DAKiKA I Başkan Erdoğan'dan Uluslararası Demokratlar Birliği Kurulu'na videolu mesaj: Türk diasporasına faydalı olacak

en.title: BREAKING: President Erdoğan sends video message to International Democrats Union Board: will benefit Turkish diaspora
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan sent a video message to the International Democrats Union Board, stating that his administration stands by its citizens and addresses matters concerning the diaspora.

en.title: Body found after entering the sea
en.summary: A 54-year-old man named Erdoğan Yılmaz drowned while swimming at Tekke Beach in Çeşme, İzmir, and his body was recovered.

stories.title: İtfaiye, dumanların sardığı binadan 7 kişiyi çıkardı

en.title: Fire department rescues 7 people from smoke-filled building
en.summary: A fire broke out on the roof of an 8-story building in Diyarbakır's Bağlar district during midday hours, and firefighters rescued seven people from the smoke-filled structure.

stories.title: Vay Kara Haydar vay! 1,5 milyar TL daha bulundu

en.title: What a Kara Haydar! An additional 1.5 billion TL found
en.summary: Authorities discovered an additional 1.5 billion Turkish lira in an investigation into money laundering involving Mehmet Fatih Tançalan, known publicly as Kara Haydar from Van, in Antalya.

stories.title: Girne’deki gemi kazasında yaşamını yitiren Mustafa'nın cenazesi toprağa verildi

en.title: Body of Mustafa, who died in ship accident in Girne, laid to rest
en.summary: A man named Mustafa died when a ship sank while traveling from Girne in Northern Cyprus to Mersin Taşucu port in Turkey. His body has been buried.

stories.title: Vanlı Kara Haydar soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: Yeni kasası Antalya'dan çıktı! 1.5 milyar TL bulundu

en.title: New development in Van-based Kara Haydar investigation: New safe found in Antalya! 1.5 billion TL discovered
en.summary: Authorities found approximately 1.5 billion Turkish lira in a business location in Antalya as part of an investigation into Mehmet Fatih Tançalan. Recent operations across five provinces led to the capture and detention of multiple suspects.

stories.title: Girne'deki gemi faciasında kaybolmuştu: 3 yaşındaki Asel'den bir iz yok! 'Çıkacak olan bir kemiğe bile razıyız'

en.title: Missing in Girne ship disaster: No trace of 3-year-old Asel! 'We would accept even a single bone'
en.summary: Following the sinking of a passenger ferry in Northern Cyprus on August 30, authorities recovered 27 bodies while search efforts continue for the remaining missing person, a young child.

stories.title: Son dakika | Ataşehir Belediyesi AK Parti'ye geçti: Başkanvekili Cumhur İttifakı adayı Serdar Orhan oldu

en.title: Breaking news | Ataşehir Municipality passes to AK Party: Vice Mayor Serdar Orhan is candidate of Coalition
en.summary: Following the arrest of Ataşehir's deputy mayor, Serdar Orhan from the ruling coalition was elected as the new deputy mayor with 18 votes in a municipal council vote.

stories.title: Bakan Bolat'tan 170 milyon liralık işlem iddiasına yanıt

en.title: Minister Bolat responds to 170 million lira transaction allegation
en.summary: Trade Minister Ömer Bolat denied allegations related to fund investigations, stating that central registry records show no 170 million lira withdrawal or account closure. He characterized the claim as document falsification created by combining multiple separate transactions over 32 months.

stories.title: Son dakika: Eyüpsultan Belediyesi CHP'de kaldı

en.title: Breaking: Eyüpsultan Municipality remains with CHP
en.summary: In a deputy mayor election held at Istanbul's Eyüpsultan Municipal Council, the CHP candidate Cafer Parlak was elected as the new deputy mayor.

stories.title: ABD'de silahlı saldırı: 9 kişi hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Armed attack in US: 9 people killed
en.summary: An armed attack in Pennsylvania resulted in nine deaths, including children.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan: UID, Türk kimliği ve kültürünün korunması için çalışıyor

en.title: President Erdoğan: UID works to protect Turkish identity and culture
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan stated that the UID organization makes significant efforts to help diaspora members maintain their identity and culture while contributing to their host societies and addressing issues like cultural racism and Islamophobia.

en.title: 27 people injured in earthquake in Panama
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, injuring 27 people according to local authorities. The U.S. Geological Survey revised the earthquake's magnitude to 7.7.
